youtube.title: Why do train berth numbers jump around so oddly? 🚆 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Indian Railways sleeper and 3AC coaches are built from repeating bays of eight berths. Berths 1 to 6 are three stacked berths on each of two facing sides, numbered lower, middle, upper, then repeat. Berths 7 and 8 are the side lower and side upper along the aisle. Divide your berth number by 8 and the remainder tells you where you will sleep.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
